prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a rear-end collision. The patient had 5 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1457; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The same service was billed twice for the same date, and the provider admitted the second charge was a repeat.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain and stiffness. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the force and direction of the impact. No prior injury to the cervical region is known from the patient history. Over five visits the patient received conservative care including range-of-motion exercises, manual therapy, and home stretching guidance. Symptoms improved steadily, and visit frequency was reduced accordingly as the patient returned toward baseline function. Cervical imaging and physical examination findings clearly support a diagnosis of cervical strain. Billing review identified that one service was recorded twice on a single visit date. On inquiry, this office acknowledged the second entry was a duplicate of the first and has issued a correction. Patient is discharged from active care with instructions to return if symptoms recur.
